settings.title: Visibility and control across every rooftop.

settings.editor:
Most stores don’t have a data problem—they have a “too many systems” problem. Halo OS pulls the signals you actually need, turns them into alerts and priorities, and helps teams execute faster across every rooftop.

Built for operator speed. Designed for dealer clarity.

settings.title: Aged inventory + pricing pressure
Lead loss + conversion leaks
Service retention + trade opportunity
What HALO OS watches for you
Agents monitor daily and surface priorities + actions.

settings.description_text: Market + turn intelligence, aged-unit alerts, smarter allocation decisions.
Cross-channel performance, waste detection, vendor scorecards that earn their keep.
Scheduling + recall capture, parts visibility, absorption and throughput signals.
Service-to-sales conversion tracking, trade-back capture, group retention scoring, and lifecycle alerts that protect your customer base.

settings.title: Your dealership. Your data. Your OS.
Built for Dealer Executives. Not dashboards.

settings.editor: Halo OS is a command center that connects your existing systems, normalizes messy data, and turns it into actions your team can execute—daily, not quarterly.

settings.title: From chaos to clarity—without the platform shuffle.

settings.editor: Most stores don’t have a data problem—they have a “too many systems” problem. Halo OS pulls the signals you actually need, turns them into alerts and priorities, and helps teams execute faster across every rooftop.

tabs.tab_title: Is Halo OS replacing my CRM / DMS / tools?
tabs.tab_content: No—Halo connects to what you already use and coordinates signals across systems so leaders get one clear view.

tabs.tab_title: Is this just dashboards?
tabs.tab_content: Dashboards are included. The real win is proactive alerts + “what to do next” recommendations.

tabs.tab_title: How fast can we launch?
tabs.tab_content: Initial rollout is designed to be quick: connect sources, validate mappings, then turn on modules.

tabs.tab_title: Can I deploy to one store or the whole group?
tabs.tab_content: Toggle Content

tabs.tab_title: Can the AI agents be customized to our tone and rules?
tabs.tab_content: Yes—agents can be configured to your operating preferences, terminology, and priorities.

tabs.tab_title: What about data ownership and privacy?
tabs.tab_content: Your data stays yours. Halo is built to help you operationalize it—without creating new silos.

tabs.tab_title: How is pricing structured?
tabs.tab_content: Typically by rooftop + enabled modules. Early access includes pilot-friendly options.
